lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Circular high-luminance clusters are visible posterior to the gills, arranged in multiple horizontal rows that form a non-linear grid across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs to create anchor nodes in a rectangular-grid orientation.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, marked by a sharp transition from higher luminance on the dorsal side to a shadowed gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, high-contrast white blobs, significantly smaller in diameter than those observed on the primary lateral flank.
